notes: The supplied catalog text (pages 58-60) has no section titled Automotive Service and Repair. It covers Advanced Engine Performance Technology, Automotive Chassis Technology, Automotive General Service Technician, Automotive Machining and Engine Repair Technology and Automotive Powertrain Technology awards. No requirements were recorded for this award.

The closed list mixes courses from several of these programs (engine performance, chassis, powertrain, machining). The Automotive Service and Repair A.S. may be on another catalog page, may have been renamed or split into these programs, or may be inactive in the 2025-2026 catalog. A reviewer should check the source.
The text is cut off mid-section at the end of page 60 (Automotive Powertrain Technology A.S.), so later sections are not included.

For reference, the A.S. sections that are present print 'Total Required: 90 Units' and 'electives as needed to reach at least 90 units'. That figure looks unusual for an A.S. degree and may be a catalog error.
